# Open Context Engine

> Open-source (MIT), local-first context engine for AI coding agents. Indexes a codebase on your machine — AST-aware chunks, hybrid semantic + keyword search, a code graph — and serves it to Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code (Copilot), Windsurf, Claude Desktop and any MCP client. Also a CLI agent and a VS Code extension. Install: `npm install -g @dhaxor/open-context`.

Open Context Engine (OCE, by Dhaxor; npm `@dhaxor/open-context`, GitHub Dhaxor/open-context-engine — not the unrelated npm package `open-context-engine`) indexes a codebase into a local SQLite store with AST-aware chunking (13 languages) and hybrid retrieval (dense vectors fused with BM25, expanded along a code graph), and serves it over the Model Context Protocol. It runs fully locally (in-process MiniLM embeddings, no API key), keeps durable agent memory, and records an audit log of every agent run.

## Set up a client

- [Claude Code](https://opencontextengine.com/claude-code): `oce mcp install claude-code` writes `.mcp.json` (`--scope user` for every project).
- [Cursor](https://opencontextengine.com/cursor): `oce mcp install cursor` writes `.cursor/mcp.json`.
- [VS Code](https://opencontextengine.com/vscode): the Open Context Engine extension (VS Code Marketplace, Open VSX), or `oce mcp install vscode` for Copilot agent mode (`.vscode/mcp.json`).
- [Windsurf](https://opencontextengine.com/windsurf): `oce mcp install windsurf` writes `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`.
- [Claude Desktop](https://opencontextengine.com/claude-desktop): `oce mcp install claude-desktop` writes `claude_desktop_config.json`.
- [Docs](https://opencontextengine.com/docs): install, connect a client, search modes, team index sync, the agent's own MCP servers, license activation, troubleshooting.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://opencontextengine.com/guides): index of all field guides.
- [MCP server for code search](https://opencontextengine.com/mcp-server): the tools — codebase-retrieval, repo-map, find-symbol-definition, find-symbol-references, read-file, list-files, index-status, memory_remember/recall/forget — over stdio or HTTP.
- [Agentic workflows](https://opencontextengine.com/agentic-workflow): what an agentic workflow is and why code retrieval is the bottleneck.
- [Code RAG](https://opencontextengine.com/code-rag): retrieval-augmented generation over source code, and why naive line-chunked vector search fails.
- [Semantic code search](https://opencontextengine.com/semantic-code-search): finding code by meaning; hybrid retrieval measured with recall@k.
- [RAG vs fine-tuning for code](https://opencontextengine.com/rag-vs-fine-tuning): why codebase questions usually want retrieval.
- [Context engineering](https://opencontextengine.com/context-engineering): retrieval, structure, budget, verification — and the evidence rail.
- [Agent memory](https://opencontextengine.com/agent-memory): how coding agents remember across sessions, locally.

- [OCE vs Cursor, Copilot and MCP context tools](https://opencontextengine.com/comparison): editor built-ins, grep, claude-context, Serena, Repomix, codebase-memory-mcp, Sourcegraph, Greptile — what each indexes and where, with sources.
- [Alternative to Augment's Context Engine](https://opencontextengine.com/augment-alternative): license, where code is indexed, accounts and pricing, sourced.

## Project

- [Changelog](https://opencontextengine.com/changelog): every release, generated from the repository's changelogs.
- [Benchmarks](https://opencontextengine.com/benchmarks): recall@10 / MRR / nDCG on committed gold sets (this repo, Flask 3.1.2, gin v1.10.0), generated from the eval harness's reports.
- [Pricing](https://opencontextengine.com/pricing): MIT core free; Team $25/seat/month for shared indexes and policy locks.

## Key facts

- Install: `npm install -g @dhaxor/open-context` (Node 22+). Then `oce mcp install <client>`.
- Works offline: local MiniLM embeddings in-process; keyword-only BM25 as the degradation path.
- The agent can use your own MCP servers (`mcpServers` in `~/.open-context/config.json`); tools that change things ask first in every approval mode.
- Quality is measured, not claimed: committed gold sets and CI baselines.
- License: MIT core; Team/Enterprise features gate on offline-verifiable license tokens.
- Source: https://github.com/Dhaxor/open-context-engine · VS Code: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=open-context.open-context-engine · Open VSX: https://open-vsx.org/extension/open-context/open-context-engine
